step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture shows the UK Met Office Severe Weather Warning System's serverless dissemination flow. A CloudWatch scheduled event periodically triggers an AWS Step Functions state machine workflow. The state machine queries an AWS API Gateway instance to check if there are active severe weather warnings in the active region. If a warning exists, the warning state is saved as a JSON object into an Amazon S3 bucket (Warnings). Step Functions then orchestrates a set of AWS Lambda functions that generate content artifacts (PDFs, SMS text, email body). Next, Step Functions reads responder notification preferences from a second S3 bucket (Preferences), which is updated in sync with an On-Premise system. Finally, Step Functions merges the warning data and preferences to trigger an external Messaging API to deliver SMS, email, and text alerts.
